title: Correct Decay Modes
description: Essential Criteria: Each particle must have a valid decay mode listed with correct final states.

title: Neutrino Types
description: Important Criteria: Specify the correct type of neutrino for decays involving neutrinos.

title: Multiple Decay Channels
description: Important Criteria: Include multiple decay channels for particles that have them, such as K^0.

title: Particle Identification
description: Important Criteria: Ensure that all particles are correctly identified and matched with their decay modes.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid incorrect signs in decay modes or missing particles in the final states.
